thread.text: And the Lord God said, It is not good that the man should be alone; I will make him an help meet for him.

classes.title: Agree Together | Bound Not Bondage

precepts.label: Genesis 3:16
precepts.why:
“I will make him an help meet for him.” To help is to give assistance or support to someone, to provide something useful or necessary in achieving an end. Meet means suitable for him. So the help is the one who assists in making what the husband wants happen. Sometimes the help thinks she is supposed to lead, or thinks she is supposed to guide, but that is not what a help is.

Genesis 3:16 comes after the transgression: “thy desire shall be to thy husband, and he shall rule over thee.” Some have taken this to mean it was only at this point that the woman was supposed to listen to her husband. No. She was told she was the help back in Genesis 2; Genesis 3:16 confirms the rule after the fall.

So why do we feel today that being a help is a bad thing? Sisters, the help is the greatest thing you are ever going to be. The moment you decide being the help is not the greatest thing you can be, or think you are supposed to be something outside of the help, you are going to destroy your marriage.

It cuts both ways. Brothers, the moment you decide not to provide, not to leave the house and work, not to be the man God told you to be, watch what happens to your household: your marriage will crumble and your life will be in shambles. It is a domino effect. And headship is maintenance, a routine thing a husband has to keep doing. A wife will never say she is trying to overthrow you, but it is in her spirit, the same way a man wants to do things his own way when he gets orders from those ranked above him. So you will have to remind her: I am the head, you have to listen to me.

precepts.label: Isaiah 3:12
precepts.why:
Write this down: women were never designed to lead men. God made the woman “an help meet” for the man, and when that order is turned around, Isaiah 3:12 calls it what it is: “As for my people, children are their oppressors, and women rule over them. O my people, they which lead thee cause thee to err, and destroy the way of thy paths.”

That is a curse. It is not a good thing; it shows things out of order, not how God set it up. A woman's body alone shows she was not made to lead men into danger: her cycle comes, she is pregnant for nine months, and she is supposed to lead you somewhere?

Women ruling over you is a curse, brothers. Some of you are scared to lead your house and have let her lead. If you are passive, scared, afraid of confrontation, she is going to walk all over you. It is not a secret; everyone sees it, and other men see it in your demeanor. You have to change the way you think. Stand up and take your place back.

The women were designed to be a help to their husbands. When they step outside of that, and when the brothers allow it, chaos follows. That is why there is dysfunction in our nation right now: because the men do not want to lead.

precepts.label: Jeremiah 31:22
precepts.why:
“How long wilt thou go about, O thou backsliding daughter? for the Lord hath created a new thing in the earth, A woman shall compass a man.” A new thing: women being over men was never heard of. It is not natural, and it is not the natural state of a man to be run by a woman. But you allow it.

God did not set it up that way. In Genesis 2 he made the woman a help meet for the man. When she compasses him instead, the order is upside down.

Cases come up where a brother does not know what is going on in his own house. His wife pays all the bills while he is on the couch playing video games, and he cannot understand why his home is in confusion. It is because his wife is running things. She has been the breadwinner from day one, so she looks at it as normal, and he is used to it. He did not want a wife; he wanted a mama.

precepts.label: Ezekiel 34:31
precepts.why:
“And ye my flock, the flock of my pasture, are men, and I am your God, saith the Lord God.” The Lord uses men to lead. It has always been that way and it is never going to change. You will not change the order of things just because you are weak, or scared of your wife.

Sisters, the beta men on social media are influencing you, making you think the man is supposed to worship the ground you walk on. That will not influence the men in purple and gold. We are not worried about being called names, narcissist or misogynist. The question is, do you want a man or do you want a boy?

When your husband gets around the brothers and comes home acting different, he is supposed to. He examines himself, sees he is lacking, and comes home on fire to fix his house, with a little more pep in his step and a little more to say. The same goes when he has been rebuked for adultery or for not dealing with his wife the right way: he is supposed to move different. It works in every area if he truly believes.

This is why there is an attack on the household. Satan and his people know that to destroy us they have to attack our foundation, and the foundation is the home. Paul warned that in the last days perilous times would come, with those “Having a form of godliness, but denying the power thereof”, and “of this sort are they which creep into houses, and lead captive silly women laden with sins, led away with divers lusts.” They get in through the phone and the conversations, whoever is influencing them. We are building a nation, and if we are not strong on the home front, we will not get off the ground.

precepts.label: Ecclesiastes 3:18
precepts.why:
“Now the serpent was more subtil than any beast of the field which the Lord God had made.” The serpent is counted among the beasts, and in the scriptures the Most High compares men to beasts. Solomon wrote, “I said in mine heart concerning the estate of the sons of men, that God might manifest them, and that they might see that they themselves are beasts.” So the serpent in Genesis 3 is a representation of a man.

He was more subtle than any beast: more crafty, better with his lies, better with his persuasion. Satan’s first weapon was persuasion. Eve was not subdued physically; he did not grab her. He came to her with words. “Yea, hath God said, Ye shall not eat of every tree of the garden?” Notice what he brings: doubt and fear. Eve answered correctly, that God had said “Ye shall not eat of it, neither shall ye touch it, lest ye die.” Then came the doubt: “Ye shall not surely die,” and “ye shall be as gods, knowing good and evil.” She was already meant to be eternal, but he threw doubt in to persuade her to eat.

“she took of the fruit thereof, and did eat, and gave also unto her husband with her; and he did eat.” She was persuaded by the serpent, and then she defiled Adam as well. The serpent used no force; he used words to sway Eve’s perception of reality, and then she went into sin. He went to the woman first, which is why the woman is to learn from her husband at home.

That same serpent spirit is still speaking. Christ told the Pharisees, “Ye are of your father the devil,” “a liar, and the father of it.” The serpent seed came through Cain, and it lives on in Esau, the so-called white man, the pioneer of lying, who persuades the world today through his media and his religion. It is a battle for the minds of the people, and the answer is to stay in the word.

precepts.label: Job 26:13
precepts.why:
When did the war start? Through the envy of the devil, when he made his move on Adam’s kingdom. And he made that move through Adam’s wife: “Now the serpent was more subtil than any beast of the field which the Lord God had made.”

The serpent is Satan, the devil. It says serpent, but it is not talking about a snake; he is called a serpent because he is slick, forked-tongued, tricky. And notice, “which the Lord God had made.” God created him to be exactly who he is. He was subtil because God made him subtil.

Job confirms it: “By his spirit he hath garnished the heavens; his hand hath formed the crooked serpent.” God formed that crooked serpent, Satan. He is not a rival power that rose up on his own to equal God; he is a creature God made, crooked by design.

So Satan tricked Eve, the weaker vessel, and caused her to sin, and Eve went and convinced her husband to sin. Then the Most High came to deal with Adam, Eve and Satan, and brought judgment on all three. From there God declared the war: “I will put enmity between thee and the woman, and between thy seed and her seed”.

That is why we have to know our adversary. The serpent that deceived Eve is the same one we fight today, in his whispers and in his children, and the one who formed him is the one who will judge him.

precepts.label: Luke 4:5-6
precepts.why:
Satan made his move on Adam through the weaker vessel, and God brought judgment on the serpent, the woman and the man. To the serpent: “Because thou hast done this, thou art cursed above all cattle, and above every beast of the field”. That is not about livestock. This is paradise; he is cursed above every creation God made there. And, “upon thy belly shalt thou go, and dust shalt thou eat all the days of thy life”.

That one line says two things. Man was made from the earth, and Satan is a celestial being, so “all the days of thy life” means his days are numbered: he will be destroyed in the future for what he did. And eating dust means he is on the earth, and the Lord handed him power over it.

Luke shows it: “the devil, taking him up into an high mountain, shewed unto him all the kingdoms of the world in a moment of time. And the devil said unto him, All this power will I give thee, and the glory of them: for that is delivered unto me; and to whomsoever I will I give it.” When was the power of this earth delivered to Satan? In Genesis 3, what we just read.

And he gave it to whom he would: first to Cain, and then to Esau, the so-called white man in these last days. That is why Esau is able to create all this technology.

Then comes the declaration of war: “I will put enmity between thee and the woman, and between thy seed and her seed”. Back then her seed was Abel, then Seth and the chosen lineage, and Satan’s seed was Cain and his descendants. Today her seed is the twelve tribes of Israel, and his seed is the so-called Caucasians, Edom. And “it shall bruise thy head”, because his seed, the Romans, crucified Christ. Then, “and thou shalt bruise his heel”: the Lord will take down Satan and his children. So when the Bible says to be soldiers of Jesus Christ, we fight Satan, his wicked thoughts and whispers, and we also fight his children, his physical counterpart.

precepts.label: Job 1:6-7
precepts.why:
“Now there was a day when the sons of God came to present themselves before the Lord, and Satan came also among them.” Satan does not run around doing his own thing. He goes before the Lord and answers to him.

“And the Lord said unto Satan, Whence comest thou? Then Satan answered the Lord, and said, From going to and fro in the earth, and from walking up and down in it.” That walking up and down in the earth is the dust he eats. In Genesis 3 God said, “upon thy belly shalt thou go, and dust shalt thou eat all the days of thy life”. Here is that judgment being lived out: his job is to walk the earth to see whom he can tempt and destroy. Satan became the tempter, and that is his judgment; soon he will be destroyed.

It happened after Satan was judged, and it shows the order of things. The power of this world was delivered to him, but he still presents himself before the Lord and reports where he has been.

The word Satan comes from a Hebrew term meaning adversary: accuser, opponent. And the word devil means deceiver. He is the Lord’s adversary and our adversary. And not only the spiritual Satan: his seed, his children, are our adversary too, because God put enmity between his seed and her seed. The so-called white man is our adversary, and the spiritual demon Satan is our adversary. That is the war we are in.

precepts.label: 1 John 3:12
precepts.why:
Genesis 4 shows Satan’s children being born in the earth. Eve bare Cain and then Abel; Abel kept sheep and Cain tilled the ground. “And the Lord had respect unto Abel and to his offering: But unto Cain and to his offering he had not respect. And Cain was very wroth”. The Lord told him, “If thou doest well, shalt thou not be accepted? and if thou doest not well, sin lieth at the door. And unto thee shall be his desire, and thou shalt rule over him.” Do good and you will be accepted; do evil and Satan will rule over you. Cain would become the child of Satan and serve him.

Then Cain talked with Abel, “and it came to pass, when they were in the field, that Cain rose up against Abel his brother, and slew him”. That is the fulfillment of Genesis 3:15, “I will put enmity between thee and the woman, and between thy seed and her seed”. The enmity started there. Cain, Satan’s seed, killed our forefather: the first murder on the earth and the first blood shed in the war.

John proves Cain was that seed: “Not as Cain, who was of that wicked one, and slew his brother. And wherefore slew he him? Because his own works were evil, and his brother’s righteous.” Cain was always evil. His descendants were the children of the devil, and they corrupted everyone on the earth, even the sons of God, until God destroyed the world. All the evil you see Esau doing on the earth today, Cain was doing back then.

Then the sons of God and the sons of the devil came back. Rebekah’s children “struggled together within her”, and the Lord said, “Two nations are in thy womb, and two manner of people shall be separated from thy bowels”. Jacob is the twelve tribes, the so-called Negroes and Hispanics; Esau is the so-called white man. This fight did not start with slavery, Jim Crow or civil rights; it started in the beginning with Cain and Abel, and was reborn as Jacob and Esau: good against evil. Many of our people followed Cain then, and many follow Esau now and have become children of the devil themselves.

Esau “came out red, all over like an hairy garment”, born without pigment, as Cain lost his when the earth cursed him. Jacob took hold on his heel, a prophetic sign of Genesis 3:15: our Lord coming to destroy Satan and his children. And when scripture says “the devil shall cast some of you into prison”, it was Herod, an Edomite, who “killed James the brother of John with the sword” and took Peter. The devil means the deceiver, and it is interchangeable: the father and his children, who can do nothing without the father that dwells in them.

precepts.label: 1 John 3:1
precepts.why:
Genesis 5 traces the lineage from Adam down to Noah, who “begat Shem, Ham, and Japheth.” Then Genesis 6 says “the sons of God saw the daughters of men that they were fair.” The sons of God are that lineage just named; the daughters of men are the daughters of the other nations that were created. These are not literal angels. The chapter before gives the understanding, and the scriptures that follow prove who the sons of God are.

John writes it in the New Testament: “Behold, what manner of love the Father hath bestowed upon us, that we should be called the sons of God.” That is what God calls us. Brothers, you are walking gods, whoever gets upset about it, the apologists included.

“therefore the world knoweth us not, because it knew him not.” The world looks at our people, calls us Negroes, and refuses to believe these could be the people of the book, the sons of God. And it knew him not: to this day they refuse to say Christ was a black man. They put the image of Cesare Borgia in every church, comic book and piece of media, while the Bible says he is black, of the tribe of Judah.

So when Genesis 6 speaks of “the sons of God” going in to the daughters of men, it is speaking of the same people John calls the sons of God: Adam’s line, our forefathers.

precepts.label: Psalms 82:6
precepts.why:
“the sons of God saw the daughters of men” in Genesis 6 is about men, not spirits; God says “My spirit shall not always strive with man, for that he also is flesh.” Psalms 82:6 shows who these sons of God are and what God calls them: “I have said, Ye are gods; and all of you are children of the most High.”

We are gods, and we are children of the Most High. That is why the sons of God in Genesis 6 are called by that name: they carried that DNA, made in the image of God.

It is also why their sin was so serious. Back in Genesis 6:4, “There were giants in the earth in those days; and also after that, when the sons of God came in unto the daughters of men.” The sons of God, the children of the Most High, took wives of the other nations, which was forbidden. The children born to them “became mighty men which were of old, men of renown,” and “God saw that the wickedness of man was great in the earth, and that every imagination of the thoughts of his heart was only evil continually.” So the Most High brought destruction, and later we had to pay for what we did as the sons of God; he told Abraham his seed would be afflicted in a land not theirs for four hundred years.

precepts.label: Deuteronomy 14:1
precepts.why:
The sons of God in Genesis 6 are Adam’s line, the lineage traced in Genesis 5. Did that name change later, after the flood and after Egypt? No. Deuteronomy 14:1, spoken after the Exodus, says to Israel: “Ye are the children of the Lord your God.”

We are the children of the Lord our God because we are the sons of God. The same people carried the same title from Adam through Noah, through the fathers, out of Egypt, and into the law.

This matters for reading Genesis 6 rightly. The sons of God who went in to the daughters of men were not angels coming down from the sky; they were men of that same chosen line, God’s own children, who mixed with the other nations when it was forbidden. That sin brought the flood, and later the affliction of our people. The scriptures do not change the name: from Genesis, to Deuteronomy, to the prophets, to the New Testament, it is our people who are called the children and the sons of God.

precepts.label: Hosea 1:10
precepts.why:
The title “sons of God” runs through the whole book. After Deuteronomy called Israel “the children of the Lord your God,” did anything change in the prophets? No. Hosea 1:10: “Yet the number of the children of Israel shall be as the sand of the sea, which cannot be measured nor numbered.”

“And it shall come to pass, that in the place where it was said unto them, Ye are not my people.” That place is where our people are today: America and the diaspora, Jamaica, Haiti, Africa, Europe. Everywhere we were told we are not God’s people. “there it shall be said unto them, Ye are the sons of the living God.”

God calls us the sons of the living God. That is who we are. So the sons of God of Genesis 6 are the same nation the prophet speaks of: the children of Israel, scattered and counted as nothing, yet still his sons. The world does not know us, but God does, and in the very place where we were called not his people, he will call us his sons again.

precepts.label: Judith 16:7
precepts.why:
Genesis 6:4 says the children of the sons of God and the daughters of men “became mighty men which were of old, men of renown,” and that “There were giants in the earth in those days.” Judith’s song names that kind of people: “For the mighty one did not fall by the young men, neither did the sons of the Titans smite him, nor high giants set upon him: but Judith the daughter of Merari weakened him with the beauty of her countenance.”

The sons of the Titans and the high giants are those giants, the men of renown of Genesis 6, the offspring of the sons of God.

That is where Esau gets his Titan movies, and his Greek mythology of Hercules and the half-gods. He always mixes some lies in with the truth. He tells those stories because he looks at us as gods: because of our DNA, our physical prowess, our melanin. We are the sons of God, demigods on the earth, and that is why when our people are put into sports or anything physical, we dominate. Everybody wants our rhythm, but nobody wants our blues.

So the Titans of the Greek stories are not fallen angels or gods of another people. They are a twisted memory of the mighty men born when the sons of God went in to the daughters of men.

precepts.label: Baruch 3:26-28
precepts.why:
Baruch says the same thing as Genesis 6: “There were the giants famous from the beginning, that were of so great stature, and so expert in war.” Those giants were the offspring of the sons of God, the mighty men of renown, and they were expert in war as well.

“Those did not the Lord choose, neither gave he the way of knowledge unto them.” God did not choose them; they were wicked. “But they were destroyed, because they had no wisdom, and perished through their own foolishness.” How were they destroyed? The flood. God saw that “every imagination of the thoughts of his heart was only evil continually,” and he wiped it out.

But those same spirits came right back, by way of the three sons of Noah, Shem, Ham and Japheth. There is no new thing under the sun. Jude speaks of “certain men crept in unawares, who were before of old ordained to this condemnation,” the same words, “of old,” that Genesis 6 uses of the men of renown. The same kind of wickedness is still here, reserved “unto the judgment of the great day,” which has not yet come.

So the giants are not a fantasy of fallen angels, the Nephilim Esau talks about. They were men, the offspring of the sons of God, who had no wisdom, and whose spirit lives on until the judgment.

precepts.label: Numbers 30:3-5
precepts.why:
Numbers 30:6-8 is about your prayers, sisters, and the power the Most High gave the husband over the wife. If the husband hears her vow and holds his peace, “then her vows shall stand”; but if he disallows her the day he hears it, “he shall make her vow which she vowed, and that which she uttered with her lips, wherewith she bound her soul, of none effect: and the Lord shall forgive her.” Some of you will go to the Most High praying against your husband, and he can say, Lord, do not listen to that trash.

Keep reading back in the chapter and it speaks of the father, for those of you who do not have a husband. It starts with the man: “If a man vow a vow unto the Lord, or swear an oath to bind his soul with a bond; he shall not break his word”.

Then: “If a woman also vow a vow unto the Lord, and bind herself by a bond, being in her father’s house in her youth”. Being where? In her father’s house. “And her father hear her vow, and her bond wherewith she hath bound her soul, and her father shall hold his peace at her: then all her vows shall stand”.

“But if her father disallow her in the day that he heareth; not any of her vows, or of her bonds wherewith she hath bound her soul, shall stand: and the Lord shall forgive her, because her father disallowed her.”

So God also gave the father power over the daughter. The same power the husband has over the wife’s vow, the father has over his daughter’s vow while she is in his house. That is the order the Most High set, and nobody made it up: do not get mad at us, we are reading the Bible.

precepts.label: Romans 8:16
precepts.why:
“Moreover all these curses shall come upon thee, and shall pursue thee, and overtake thee, till thou be destroyed”. I don't care what country you are in, what state, what continent: these curses are following us. That's why we're getting shot down in the streets and killed left and right; the Most High has to do something to wake us back up. We are a destroyed nation, and we haven't understood that yet.

“And they shall be upon thee for a sign and for a wonder”. The curses are the sign. That is how we know we are the Israelites: the Bible gives us the signs to look out for, in Deuteronomy 28:15-68 and in Genesis 49, and if our spirit resonates with those signs, we are going to realize that we are the Israelites.

That is Romans 8:16: “The Spirit itself beareth witness with our spirit, that we are the children of God”. That we, the Israelites, are the children of God. Not the whole world. The spirit itself, the Bible, bears witness with our spirit that we are those children.

And “for a wonder”: we are supposed to be wondering what happened. We are the greatest people on earth; how did we get so low? It will be upon our seed for ever, upon our children until Christ's return. Brothers want to argue the trinity while our people are being killed, holding the name Israel and refusing everything that goes with it. The sign is on us, and the spirit bears witness with ours: we are Israel, and we have to come back to the Lord.

precepts.label: Hosea 2:8
precepts.why:
Judges says Israel “served Baalim” and “forsook the Lord God of their fathers, which brought them out of the land of Egypt”. Hosea shows how ungrateful that was: “For she did not know that I gave her corn, and wine, and oil, and multiplied her silver and gold, which they prepared for Baal.”

That is what the Lord did for Israel. He clothed us, gave us land, gave us food and possessions, all of that. And we turned around and prepared it for Baal; we started serving the devil with what God gave us. Baal, Baalim, it is the same thing: the Canaanite god of fertility, storms, thunder and lightning, worshipped in horrible ways, whose name means lord or master. He sounds like Thor. Baal and Ashtaroth have taken on so many names over the ages, which is why we rarely hear of them, but the worship is coming back to light.

Even now it goes on. Just days before this class, thousands of Afro-Brazilians gathered on a Rio beach to offer gifts to a sea goddess, Yemanja, revered in the Yoruba religion as the mother of all orishas and humanity. Brazil is the tribe of Asher. It is the same deity all throughout: “the women knead their dough, to make cakes to the queen of heaven”. Ashtaroth, the queen of heaven, Yemanja, whatever the name. Our people carried that witchcraft with them and kept doing it, even in Africa.

That's our history, and that is why we are in captivity today, catching hell. The Lord clothed us and named us, yet even in 2026 our people are still worshipping the devil, and we wonder why America goes down there stealing presidents, starving people out and destabilizing countries.

precepts.label: Leviticus 18:21
precepts.why:
“And thou shalt not let any of thy seed pass through the fire to Molech, neither shalt thou profane the name of thy God: I am the Lord.” Molech worship went along with the fertility gods: it dealt with children, with the womb. That is what we were doing, and it is exactly what God told us not to do. We became bullheaded and stubborn and started worshipping the devil. That is how Israel “forsook the Lord, and served Baal and Ashtaroth.”

Stubbornness runs through this whole history. “A stubborn heart shall fare evil at the last; and he that loveth danger shall perish therein.” So we have to prophesy against the idolatry and come up out of this foolishness: Christmas, Valentine's Day, which a lot of our people celebrated. It has nothing to do with us. God did not give it to us.

“Bow down his neck while he is young, and beat him on the sides while he is a child, lest he wax stubborn”. That is why God's laws are taught without going to the left or the right: we know how we got over here, through stubbornness. If we want to be delivered, we have to wake up.

It is how Israel gets down: “when the judge was dead, that they returned, and corrupted themselves more than their fathers, in following other gods to serve them, and to bow down unto them; they ceased not from their own doings, nor from their stubborn way.” When there is no judge, no leader, in place, they go back to their lonesome: the officer's not here, the captain's not here, the Deacon's not here, the Bishop ain't here. If you can't uphold righteousness when nobody is looking, the same judgment is your future. Stubborn goes back to bullheaded, and bullheaded goes back to Baal.

“For rebellion is as the sin of witchcraft, and stubbornness is as iniquity and idolatry.” Stubbornness is idolatry; it is satanic worship. So many think they are not dabbling in the mystic arts, but when you are stubborn and rebellious, you are: “sorcerers, and idolaters, and all liars, shall have their part in the lake which burneth with fire and brimstone”.

“But the fearful, and unbelieving, and the abominable, and murderers, and whoremongers, and sorcerers, and idolaters, and all liars, shall have their part in the lake which burneth with fire and brimstone.”

A lot of y’all think, I’m not dabbling in the mystic arts. Yes, you are. When you are stubborn and rebellious, yes, you are. It says sorcerers and idolaters. The Lord was sick of it and still is, and this is the last time.

precepts.label: 1 Kings 22:19-23
precepts.why:
In Job, “the sons of God came to present themselves before the Lord, and Satan came also among them. And the Lord said unto Satan, Whence comest thou?” But I thought he got kicked out of heaven and was one of the fallen ones? No. He is there because he works for God. God created good angels and bad angels, and Satan’s job is to tempt us; he is only allowed to do what God allows. The prophet Micaiah saw the same court of heaven.

“I saw the Lord sitting on his throne, and all the host of heaven standing by him on his right hand and on his left.” The angels on the right hand go forth for righteousness, and the ones on the left go forth for evil, for judgment.

“And the Lord said, Who shall persuade Ahab, that he may go up and fall at Ramoth–gilead?” One said one thing and another said another. “And there came forth a spirit, and stood before the Lord, and said, I will persuade him.” “I will go forth, and I will be a lying spirit in the mouth of all his prophets. And he said, Thou shalt persuade him, and prevail also: go forth, and do so.”

God gave that spirit the authority to do it, the same way he gave Satan the authority in Job 1 to tempt Job: destroy everything, but do not touch Job himself. Even the lying spirit stands before the throne and goes out only when the Lord sends it. That is why the fallen angel doctrine is crap, and why it is a shame to hear black pastors, not only Edomite pastors, repeating that same garbage rhetoric and defiling the minds of the people.

precepts.label: Psalms 103:20-22
precepts.why:
“Bless the Lord, ye his angels, that excel in strength, that do his commandments, hearkening unto the voice of his word.” That do his commandments. I thought he kicked them out of heaven because they were disobedient and tried to overthrow him, and now they are fallen? No: they do his commandments. We just read about the spirit sent forth in 1 Kings 22, and about Satan working for the Most High in Job 1. The angels hearken unto the voice of the Most High.

“Bless ye the Lord, all ye his hosts; ye ministers of his, that do his pleasure.” Keep that word ministers in mind. They minister unto the Most High, doing his pleasure, and they also minister unto us.

“Bless the Lord, all his works in all places of his dominion: bless the Lord, O my soul.” Every angel in every place of his dominion is under his rule, carrying out his commandments, which is why Satan could only go as far as the Lord allowed him with Job.

precepts.label: Hebrews 1:14
precepts.why:
The psalm calls the angels “ministers of his, that do his pleasure.” They minister unto the Most High, but they minister unto us as well: “Are they not all ministering spirits, sent forth to minister for them who shall be heirs of salvation?”

Who is going to be heir of salvation? Us, if we keep the commandments. So the angels work on our behalf. They are ministering spirits, sent forth by God for his people.

So the angels that come before the Lord in Job 1 are not rebels running loose. They are sent forth at his word, whether to try a man like Job or to minister for the heirs of salvation.

precepts.label: Ecclesiasticus 39:28-31
precepts.why:
This shows how the angels do what the Most High tells them. “There be spirits that are created for vengeance, which in their fury lay on sore strokes; in the time of destruction they pour out their force, and appease the wrath of him that made them.” Those are the angels on the left hand of God, and they minister unto God and to us.

“Fire, and hail, and famine, and death, all these were created for vengeance; Teeth of wild beasts, and scorpions, serpents, and the sword punishing the wicked to destruction.”

Here is the point: “They shall rejoice in his commandment, and they shall be ready upon earth, when need is; and when their time is come, they shall not transgress his word.” They do what God tells them to do. They do not have free will to say, let’s go down and sleep with some human women today. That is not what goes on in the heavens.

So when Satan went forth to touch all that Job had, he was doing what God allowed and no more. Even the spirits made for vengeance do not transgress his word.

precepts.label: Psalms 34:7
precepts.why:
The angels minister unto the Most High, and they minister unto us. “The angel of the Lord encampeth round about them that fear him, and delivereth them.” These are the good angels. They encamp around them that fear him and deliver them from all evil, like it says in the Lord’s prayer.

Our forefathers never looked at the angels as some demonic thing that came down to earth to persecute and kill them. When three men stood by Abraham in the plains of Mamre, he ran to meet them, bowed himself, had water fetched to wash their feet and prepared a calf for them to eat. When two angels came to Sodom, Lot rose up to meet them, bowed with his face to the ground and made them a feast, and they did eat. They look like us.

The angel in Revelation told John, I am thy fellow servant and of thy brethren; the angels have tribes too. Raphael presented the prayers of the saints. They are our brothers, working on our behalf. Calling them demons and fallen angels is Esau’s popular persuasion. The angel of the Lord camps round about them that fear God, just as the Lord set a hedge about Job, and delivers them.

precepts.label: Job 42:5-6
precepts.why:
Job ends where chapter 32 began. There the three men ceased to answer him “because he was righteous in his own eyes”, and Elihu was angry “because he justified himself rather than God.” Here Job says, “I have heard of thee by the hearing of the ear: but now mine eye seeth thee. Wherefore I abhor myself, and repent in dust and ashes.”

Job hated himself and repented. He repented for justifying himself and not God, for being righteous in his own eyes. He had said, I am righteous, this is not supposed to happen to me; I made a covenant with mine eyes, I don't look at other women, I am not weak like Adam, I don't hide sin in my bosom. That was his flaw. He was over-righteous, and the Lord did not like it.

In his own eyes Job did not look at it as though there was a reason God was doing this, that God was trying to make him better. In his mind it was, I am righteous, I am not like this person or that person. So the Bible says, “Be not righteous over much; neither make thyself over wise: why shouldest thou destroy thyself?” That person who tries to act over-righteous just ends up looking fake; nobody knows everything and nobody is perfect.

This is the war within, the war nobody sees. Everything Job suffered before was physical, but Satan was attacking his mind too. The Lord used what Job went through to show him what was inside himself, and that is what Satan's attacks do: they show you things inside yourself. Through all of it Job was made perfect, and he came out of it repenting in dust and ashes, justifying God instead of himself.

And the one who takes that work for a little house and a little bank account condemns his soul forever. But the Lord “disappointeth the devices of the crafty”, and “he saveth the poor from the sword, from their mouth”: from the lies of their media.

The ten horns is Europe. They are going to hate America. To make her “desolate” is to destroy this place. To make her “naked” is to expose her: your sins showing, your shame showing. A lot of the evil America and Europe did together is going to be exposed.

You see it happening today. Europe is saying you are wrong for what Israel did in Palestine, killing all these kids, and they brought charges against Netanyahu and put a warrant out for his arrest for war crimes. Job shows the same end for the wicked man: “The heaven shall reveal his iniquity; and the earth shall rise up against him.” The heaven revealing his iniquity starts with us: as we teach the word of God, the angels make things happen, Europe starts showing America's shame, and everybody sees the oppressor for what she is, and not just America but Israel too. Then “a fire not blown shall consume him”: a fire you do not have to fan, the nuclear bomb, and “it shall go ill with him that is left in his tabernacle”, left here in America.

The earth that rises up against him is the nations. Isaiah shows it: “Hell from beneath is moved for thee to meet thee at thy coming”, hell being that low condition everybody on the earth is in, and “it hath raised up from their thrones all the kings of the nations.” “How art thou fallen from heaven, O Lucifer, son of the morning!” How are you fallen from ruling, O America. All nations rise up to fight against America and destroy her.

So leave social media alone. It was created to monitor you, brainwash you and control you. God is going to save the poor from their mouth, and their own tongue will bring them down.

precepts.label: Tobit 8:7
precepts.why:
Marriage was designed to happen when you are young: you meet a young woman, and this is the person you grow old with. “rejoice with the wife of thy youth.” Tobias prayed the same thing on his wedding night: “And now, O Lord, I take not this my sister for lust but uprightly: therefore mercifully ordain that we may become aged together.”

Hands went up around the room for five, ten, fifteen, twenty and twenty-five years of marriage and more, and the Bishop has been married 36 years. These are the examples we have right here. Those married a long time are supposed to still be able to look at their wife or husband and see when they were young. That is why they can be content: both of you change, both of you get old, but you remember.

“let her breasts satisfy thee at all times; and be thou ravished always with her love.” When you marry her young her breasts are at three o'clock; as you grow old together they will be at six. But they are yours, brother, no matter what time it is. You walk in the room and she is the only thing you see. That bond can't be broken if you are in the Lord.

So we pray we are able to see our older years together. Some of us make it there and some don't; let it be because of passing, not because you weren't applying the scriptures or listening in class. The prophecy classes are dope, but you have to have the same zeal for the classes on marriage and repentance and apply them in your everyday life. Otherwise your marriage falls apart, your kids go who knows where, and then you look at us like it was our fault.

precepts.label: Acts 8:28-31
precepts.why:
“A wise son heareth his father’s instruction”. When you first come in as a brother, you are still attached to the life you are coming out of; somebody has to instruct you. Acts shows it. The eunuch “Was returning, and sitting in his chariot read Esaias the prophet. Then the Spirit said unto Philip, Go near, and join thyself to this chariot. And Philip ran thither to him, and heard him read the prophet Esaias, and said, Understandest thou what thou readest?”

We study and we get certain instructions, but is there a follow-up? When we give an instruction, do we follow up and ask, did you understand what I'm telling you to do? Or is it, boy, I said do it, do it, until the kid is intimidated and afraid to do it? Are we checking whether the person is actually ascertaining the instructions, or just repeating what they see and trying to make it?

Black people will buy something that has to be put together, dump all the pieces out, look at the picture on the box and put it together like that instead of reading the instructions. That is what we do with the scriptures. We read and study, but are we challenging ourselves on what we study? Are we asking the questions and going back to say, I'm reading this, but I don't understand any of it? And as leaders, are we giving the instructions to the people?

“And he said, How can I, except some man should guide me? And he desired Philip that he would come up and sit with him.” We all have to be guided in the instruction we are getting. You can't just tell a person to go do something. We are all instructed until it becomes habit, and that is how a son learns to hear his father's instruction instead of becoming the scorner who hears not rebuke.

But when it regroups, it builds more muscle and makes you look stronger, and when you look stronger you feel stronger and sit up a little more. Shout out to the Greensmen and the brothers that got necks: they were fat and their neck sat down in their shoulders, then they slimmed down and now you can see they've got a neck. People start praising you: bro, what are you doing? Something about you changed.

Evil success comes with sorrow; the blessing of the Lord adds none.

precepts.label: Titus 1:13
precepts.why:
“A true witness delivereth souls”: a true prophet, a true servant, delivers souls. Paul shows how a true witness does it: “This witness is true. Wherefore rebuke them sharply, that they may be sound in the faith.”

It is our job, brothers, to rebuke our people sharply. Why? That they may be sound in the faith; that they may repent. That is how souls are delivered.

So whose soul have you been delivering? You have been sitting here five years, seven years, ten years; some of you cannot even deliver your own soul, because you forgot the mission. Who are you working for, spiritually: Messiah or Satan? Some of you are agents working for Esau.

“but a deceitful witness speaketh lies.” Our people love lies, and the deceitful witness feeds them lies. That is why you see ten thousand, twenty thousand in the Christian churches: they do not want the truth. They say Christ cannot be black, Christ cannot come only for the Israelite. The truth to us is a foreign language. That is why the true witness has to rebuke sharply: sharp rebuke is what brings a people who love lies to repentance.

precepts.label: Romans 8:29
precepts.why:
“In the fear of the Lord is strong confidence.” Some of you have no confidence and low self-esteem because you have no fear of God, sitting in the same seat for seven years. Romans shows what God called you for: “For whom he did foreknow, he also did predestinate to be conformed to the image of his Son, that he might be the firstborn among many brethren.”

What does it mean to be conformed? To change. We must change to the image of Jesus Christ. Some of you have not changed yet, and we can see it.

We can see the potential on you: this brother has the spirit to do great things in Israel. But you have to see it. My job as a deacon is to push your spirit and to build you up, but no matter how much I build you up, if you cannot see it, I cannot make you see it. You have to get up and see it yourself.

There is a lot of work to do while you are waiting for the kingdom, and the kingdom does not come by observation. When temptation and tribulation come, the one who has not been conformed will run, because mentally and spiritually he is not strong enough to endure it. Being predestinated to be conformed means you have to do the changing.

precepts.label: Ephesians 1:5
precepts.why:
“Having predestinated us unto the adoption of children by Jesus Christ to himself, according to the good pleasure of his will.” The same God who foreknew us and predestinated us to be conformed to the image of his Son predestinated us unto the adoption of children, by Jesus Christ, to himself.

That calling is what the class carried straight into Paul: “For though I preach the gospel, I have nothing to glory of: for necessity is laid upon me; yea, woe is unto me, if I preach not the gospel!” Paul understood he was a servant, sent to serve the people and deliver souls. Destruction unto me if I do not do what I was sent to do.

“For if I do this thing willingly, I have a reward.” You have to do it willingly, not because somebody forced you; a brother forced to do something has no spirit in it. Yet some of you get up at four in the morning and willingly give the white man eight or twelve hours without complaining, while coming here on the Sabbath is a burden.

So being predestinated as children by Jesus Christ is not a reason to sit and wait. God did not call you here just to sit and listen. It is a call to be the true witness that delivers souls, and in the fear of the Lord is the strong confidence to do it.

precepts.label: Ezekiel 24:12
precepts.why:
“She openeth her mouth with wisdom; and in her tongue is the law of kindness.” That is the kind of wife you want, brothers. There was no kindness or wisdom in the email that attacked leadership over the one instance of a leader put out for adultery, while ignoring the three bishops and the seven or eight deacons who were in the midst of no such thing. For every solution we try to give, that spirit has two problems. That is not wife material; they are idolatrous women, some of them idolatrous evil black women, and they will try to destroy your life. Be mindful who you marry.

Now see what language God uses when Israel is in the midst of sin; he uses it in the female context: “She hath wearied herself with lies, and her great scum went not forth out of her”. There is one word that is often wanted but is hurtful to say, so God says it. Your scum is still in your mouth, sisters.

Scum is a layer of foul or unwanted matter that forms on top of a liquid, such as pond scum or soap scum. Informally it means a despised, immoral or worthless person or group, the scum of the earth. The slang meaning goes further: the epitome of a worthless, good-for-nothing human, at the bottom of the hierarchy of humans, possibly the worst word you can have your name associated with. It describes someone so disgraceful they are seen as the lowest form of life: worthlessness, a waste of skin, dirt, nothing. Because it is perfectly acceptable English and not a swear, it is even more demeaning; it is used only when it is the only word for the job, and it makes the victim feel like the lowest of the low.

That is the word God chose for his own people when she wore herself out with lies and the wickedness would not come out of her. Some of these evil sisters are the scum of the earth; that is what God is saying. So examine yourself, and open your mouth with wisdom and the law of kindness instead.

precepts.label: Ecclesiastes 6:10
precepts.why:
“The thing that hath been, it is that which shall be”. What is the thing? Solomon tells you in chapter 6: “That which hath been is named already, and it is known that it is man: neither may he contend with him that is mightier than he.” The thing is man on earth.

So “that which is done is that which shall be done”: whether man keeps the commandments or does not keep the commandments. “and there is no new thing under the sun.” From the time of Genesis, as it has been is going to be so in these last days. There are no new incidents on this earth; the things done by man are the things that were done in the past. And “There is no remembrance of former things”, because the spirits from the past return to the future.

Paul says the same in different words: “For whatsoever things were written aforetime were written for our learning, that we through patience and comfort of the scriptures might have hope.” Written for our learning today, because the things done in the past reoccur. In a Christian mind everything is new; but nothing is new. To deal with these reoccurring events, we must read the history and testimonies of our ancestors.

Ezra shows it too: “I will liken my judgment unto a ring”. A ring is a circle, “like as there is no slackness of the last, even so there is no swiftness of the first.” It is a continual event that reoccurs over and over. And the Lord “used similitudes, by the ministry of the prophets”, comparing one thing to another.

That is why what we read in Daniel 3, Nebuchadnezzar setting up his golden image, is coming to pass again with the Trump administration and the golden statue the pastors prayed over. The man that hath been is the man that shall be.

Frolic produces an image of comfort that is false. The athlete makes millions running up and down the court and thinks he has made it, but the real soul of him knows he is still a slave. Keeping us in the silly mode makes us consumers, not people who run our own banks and medical centers.

Kaepernick caught the fever. He looked at what was happening to his people while he was up there throwing the ball, got serious and stood up, and you saw how they dealt with him. His teammates know he did the right thing, but they have to pretend they are all right. That pretending is the fear: they stay in that mess and never stand up to be men, lying to themselves that they are comfortable being clowns.

So the watchmen of Isaiah 62 cannot hold their peace. We cannot drown out the horrible squeaking of our wretched condition, the psychological traumas we live through, with frolic, drugs, alcohol or music. We cannot be dancing slaves made to look whole while inside there is a spiritual rot we can no longer afford. We must stand up and be real men and women, keep not silence, and give the Lord no rest.

precepts.label: Romans 7:15
precepts.why:
The foundational question is: am I who I was created to be, or am I what I was conditioned to become? It is not a surface-level question; it is an identity question that deals with the real soul of man and woman. Everything about us, our patterns, our responses, our beliefs, our defenses, has been shaped by one of two forces: creation or conditioning. Creation speaks to design; conditioning speaks to experience. One is intentional, the other reactive. One reflects origin, the image God made; the other reflects adaptation, to slavery, to ghettos, to being taken advantage of, to being unclean, a gang member, a drug addict. That is not who we really are, and most people live somewhere in between without ever telling the two apart.

Paul shows that fight in Romans 7:15: “For that which I do I allow not: for what I would, that do I not; but what I hate, that do I.” What he ends up doing, the real him does not allow. What his spirit would do, the conditioned self will not follow. And what the real him hates, the righteous part connected to God that hates evil, he does anyway, acting from conditioning and not from what the Lord made him to be. “If then I do that which I would not, I consent unto the law that it is good.” That duality goes on with us every day.

Christ said you must deny yourself. The you that does the denying is the part God is dealing with; the self is the composite of the conditioning you were made into. So examine your own thoughts and behaviors and ask: why am I behaving like this? Is this the real me, or a response to what I have been conditioned to be?

Most of the time when we deal with our people, we are dealing with the mask, the representative, like the man holding up a sign in front of himself. The real soul is buried and scared, hiding under a tarp of trauma, lies, deceit and psychological hang-ups. The greatness buried under self-doubt has not surfaced yet. That is what is meant by the Negro being made in a lab: the real him has not stood up. We have to encourage that real spirit to come forward and be the image God made.

precepts.label: Genesis 1:27-28
precepts.why:
You were created with intention: not randomly formed, not accidentally designed, not undefined in purpose. You have a purpose; you just lost your way. “So God created man in his own image, in the image of God created he him; male and female created he them. And God blessed them, and God said unto them, Be fruitful, and multiply, and replenish the earth, and subdue it: and have dominion.” Replenish the earth means have babies.

This is the original declaration, not only about humanity in general but about you specifically, the real soul of man and woman. Not the whore, the drug addict, the drug dealer they told you that you are. The real you is about righteousness, and you cannot define yourself by the conditioning of how you have been made to look. Conditioning says, we want to make a slave out of him, out of her, and make them think that is what they innately are. That is the point of saying the Negro was created in a lab: the real him has not stood up yet, the real us has not even surfaced yet.

You were made in the image of God, not in the image of your dysfunction. Not the image of your traumatic experiences, even though we have been through all kinds of trauma. Not the image crafted by an unstable childhood, an abusive relationship, or an environment that never reflected your worth back to you. Where it was said that we are not his people, it shall be said that we are the sons and daughters of God. We are not what they say we are; we are what God said we are. Carry yourselves that way and teach it to your children, because this world will turn them upside down if you are not serious about it.

Before conditioning entered, before survival strategies developed, before the false self was built, there was an image, an original design, and that design carries attributes: the capacity for creativity, for dominion, the capacity to rule, and for fruitfulness, children and nationhood. These are not just aspirations, like a novel we read. They are original; they are in our DNA, placed in us before the world opened its lips to say anything. When people see what we build and say it must be a sellout, that is a dysfunctional mind that believes we can't do anything. Men and women, whatever you went through, you can fix it. In IUIC we told everyone who said we couldn't to go to hell, and we did what we had to do.

precepts.label: Exodus 11:7
precepts.why:
The attributes of the image were placed in us before the world had its say, and Exodus 11:7 shows how God guards his people: “But against any of the children of Israel shall not a dog move his tongue, against man or beast: that ye may know how that the Lord doth put a difference between the Egyptians and Israel.”

Are we the children of Israel? Then not a dog shall open its lips against us. No one can talk against us or anything that belongs to us. The Lord put a difference so that the world may know. We are his holy jewels, the jewellery God will wear around his neck, the apple of his eye. When they speak against us, they are speaking against his jewels and his people.

Carry yourselves like that, and never mind people who say you can't boast. Even in captivity: it is only temporary. We are not the finished product of what they did to us. A day is coming when this will be gone, and everything that ever spoke against our people will face judgment. They say, you don't talk like a slave. That is because we are not slaves.

Be like Christ. On the cross, he knew he could call down legions to wipe them out in the blink of an eye, because he already had the power, and he says we will be joint heirs with him. The world is scared to death that we will ever make that connection. They do not want us connected to that kind of power.

precepts.label: Isaiah 43:21
precepts.why:
“This people have I formed for myself; they shall shew forth my praise.” This people is the Israelites, Judah: God formed us for himself, to show forth his praise, and all the other nations will catch hell.

Put that in your spirit and put it in your children's spirit. Teach your children they are superior, because they are. The world tells us lies: it shows us Superman and Batman and all kinds of fools on TV and makes us think we are nothing but criminals. Then, when we say the reverse, they try the Jedi mind trick and make us think we are doing something wrong. That is why sons need fathers in the household who think this way, so they grow up in the right posture.

We were not formed for survival or to be a product of our environment. We were formed for a purpose that comes from outside our circumstances, connected to the nature and intent of the Most High who formed us. That is Jeremiah 1:5: “Before I formed thee in the belly I knew thee; and before thou camest forth out of the womb I sanctified thee.” Before the sperm hit the egg, we already existed and were known by him, and he chose which spirit to send, this one rather than that one, for a purpose. “and I ordained thee a prophet unto the nations”: whatever the Lord ordained us to be, we will be. He made us the children of Israel and put talents in us. That is why those talents must be organized and not wasted. Don't bring self-doubt; get the doubt out and let the real you stay and be built up.

This kingdom of Persia and Media is very significant for what is going on today. The Achaemenid Empire of Old Persian was an ancient Iranian empire, founded by Cyrus the Great in 550 BC. The bear of Daniel 7 is Iran.

And the Lord worked through that Persian king. “the Lord stirred up the spirit of Cyrus king of Persia”, and Cyrus proclaimed, “The Lord God of heaven hath given me all the kingdoms of the earth; and he hath charged me to build him an house at Jerusalem, which is in Judah.” The Lord spoke to him, and he listened. “and the kingdom shall not be left to other people, but it shall break in pieces and consume all these kingdoms”. precepts.label: Romans 9:17-21
precepts.why:

“Nay but, O man, who art thou that repliest against God? Shall the thing formed say to him that formed it, Why hast thou made me thus? precepts.label: Mark 11:4-7

“Rejoice greatly, O daughter of Zion; shout, O daughter of Jerusalem: behold, thy King cometh unto thee”. We have to believe our king is coming. He “is just, and having salvation; lowly, and riding upon an ass, and upon a colt the foal of an ass.”

Mark shows the history of what Zechariah was prophesying: “And they went their way, and found the colt tied by the door without in a place where two ways met; and they loose him. And certain of them that stood there said unto them, What do ye, loosing the colt? And they said unto them even as Jesus had commanded: and they let them go. And they brought the colt to Jesus, and cast their garments on him; and he sat upon him.”

So when people say Christ isn't mentioned in the Old Testament, shut up; you don't know what you're talking about. Zechariah saw the King of Zion riding upon the colt, and Mark records Christ sitting upon that colt. He is our King, just and having salvation, and he is coming to the daughter of Zion.

precepts.label: Psalms 72:8
precepts.why:
Zechariah says the King “shall speak peace unto the heathen: and his dominion shall be from sea even to sea, and from the river even to the ends of the earth.” David says the same: “He shall have dominion also from sea to sea, and from the river unto the ends of the earth.” And he reads on: “They that dwell in the wilderness shall bow before him; and his enemies shall lick the dust.”

They are scared of the saying from the river to the sea. Well, that's in the Bible too. And it is not just that little area. It is from sea to sea, meaning the whole planet earth is ours. When we went into the land, the Lord gave us that portion according to the number of the children of Israel, but the whole earth really belongs to us, to the ends of the earth.

In that day “I will cut off the chariot from Ephraim, and the horse from Jerusalem, and the battle bow shall be cut off”, meaning we would have no military during that time. The King's dominion is our defence, and his enemies shall lick the dust.

precepts.label: Hebrews 13:20
precepts.why:
Zechariah says, “As for thee also, by the blood of thy covenant I have sent forth thy prisoners out of the pit wherein is no water.” What is the blood of thy covenant? Hebrews shows it: “Now the God of peace, that brought again from the dead our Lord Jesus, that great shepherd of the sheep, through the blood of the everlasting covenant”.

The blood of the everlasting covenant is Christ dying on the cross. By that blood God sends forth his prisoners out of the pit.

If you didn't know it, this is the pit. Like it says, yea, though I walk through the valley of the shadow of death; Ezekiel 37 calls America the valley of dry bones. This is the pit, and “no water” means there is no truth here.

Then Zechariah says, “Turn you to the strong hold, ye prisoners of hope”. We are the prisoners of hope, and the stronghold is the Lord, this Bible: “The Lord is good, a strong hold in the day of trouble; and he knoweth them that trust in him.” By Christ's blood we are brought out of the pit to the stronghold.

precepts.label: Nahum 1:7
precepts.why:
Zechariah says “Turn you to the strong hold, ye prisoners of hope.” Nahum tells us what that stronghold is: “The Lord is good, a strong hold in the day of trouble; and he knoweth them that trust in him.” The stronghold is the Lord, and that means this Bible.

The verse before in Zechariah speaks of the pit “wherein is no water”, meaning there is no truth. That pit is America, the valley of dry bones of Ezekiel 37. Out of that pit, the prisoners are told to turn to the stronghold.

So turning to the stronghold is turning to the Lord and his word. He is good, he is our strong hold in the day of trouble, and he knows them that trust in him. We are the prisoners of hope, and the Bible calls us that.

precepts.label: Proverbs 1:23
precepts.why:
Zechariah says turn you to the stronghold; Proverbs says “Turn you at my reproof: behold, I will pour out my spirit unto you, I will make known my words unto you.” God's reproof is his laws.

So there is a stipulation to get God's Holy Spirit: you must turn at God's reproof. The laws come before the spirit. Only when you turn to his laws will he pour out his spirit on you and make known his words to you.

That is why all these dumb Christians that say they have the Holy Spirit and won't keep a commandment do not have it. They have Satan on them. Turning to the stronghold, for us prisoners of hope, means turning at his reproof and keeping his laws.

precepts.label: John 14:15-18
precepts.why:
More proof that the spirit comes after the laws: Christ said the same thing. “If ye love me, keep my commandments. And I will pray the Father, and he shall give you another Comforter, that he may abide with you for ever”.

Who is that Comforter? “Even the Spirit of truth; whom the world cannot receive, because it seeth him not, neither knoweth him: but ye know him; for he dwelleth with you, and shall be in you.” Then Christ says, “I will not leave you comfortless: I will come to you.” He is letting us know he is the Comforter. It ain't Muhammad. Christ is the Comforter; he is the Holy Spirit.

So the one who turns to the stronghold and keeps the commandments is the one who receives Christ, the Spirit of truth. Those who claim the Holy Spirit and keep no commandment do not have him.

People don't reject the truth because it is false; they reject it because it is uncomfortable. Black and Latino people hate the discomfort of change. But knowledge you won't act on just sits there and becomes nothing, like people who say they want to lose weight, know what to do, and won't do a damn thing.

precepts.label: 1 Peter 3:19-20
precepts.why:
Why does Zechariah call us prisoners of hope? Peter says Christ “went and preached unto the spirits in prison”. When Christ came, he preached to the spirits in prison. That's us: our mothers and fathers, our sons and daughters. We are in a spiritual prison.

When Rome was dominating us, that was a prison. We didn't have free rule; Rome was over us.

Those spirits in prison are the ones “Which sometime were disobedient, when once the longsuffering of God waited in the days of Noah, while the ark was a preparing, wherein few, that is, eight souls were saved by water.” That disobedient people is you and me. We are the prisoners, and our hope is in the stronghold.

precepts.label: Isaiah 61:1
precepts.why:
Isaiah shows what Christ was sent to do for those prisoners: “The Spirit of the Lord God is upon me; because the Lord hath anointed me to preach good tidings unto the meek; he hath sent me to bind up the brokenhearted, to proclaim liberty to the captives, and the opening of the prison to them that are bound”.

We are in a prison house, and we are bound in sin. Christ is anointed to proclaim liberty to us captives and to open the prison to us that are bound.

That is why we are prisoners of hope: the prison is real, but the one anointed to open it has come, and we are told to turn to him, the stronghold.

precepts.label: John 8:32-34
precepts.why:
Christ said, “And ye shall know the truth, and the truth shall make you free.” They answered him, “We be Abraham’s seed, and were never in bondage to any man: how sayest thou, Ye shall be made free?” So they knew being made free referred to being in bondage. They said, we were never slaves.

They couldn't see that Rome was over them. They were paying taxes to Rome and were oblivious to it, because they were rich and wealthy.

So watch what Christ says: “Verily, verily, I say unto you, Whosoever committeth sin is the servant of sin.” He took it down a level: you won't understand what I just said, but you are a servant. You are bound in your sins.

That is the prison of the prisoners of hope: bound under the nations and bound in sin. The truth, turning to the stronghold, is what makes us free.

precepts.label: Romans 6:12-13
precepts.why:
If sin is the prison, Paul tells us how to walk out of it: “Let not sin therefore reign in your mortal body, that ye should obey it in the lusts thereof.” Don't let sin reign, meaning rule, within you.

“Neither yield ye your members as instruments of unrighteousness unto sin: but yield yourselves unto God, as those that are alive from the dead, and your members as instruments of righteousness unto God.”

Our bodies must be vessels of righteousness, used for the commandments of God and nothing else. That is how the prisoners of hope turn to the stronghold: no longer servants of sin, but instruments of righteousness unto God.

precepts.label: Isaiah 61:7-9
precepts.why:
Zechariah says “even to day do I declare that I will render double unto thee”. Isaiah shows what that double is: “For your shame ye shall have double”. The shame we have suffered in captivity after captivity, we shall have double for it.

“and for confusion they shall rejoice in their portion”, because we are a confused people; take a look at TikTok and Instagram. “therefore in their land they shall possess the double: everlasting joy shall be unto them.” God says “I the Lord love judgment, I hate robbery for burnt offering; and I will direct their work in truth, and I will make an everlasting covenant with them.”

Watch the double we are going to get: “And their seed shall be known among the Gentiles, and their offspring among the people: all that see them shall acknowledge them, that they are the seed which the Lord hath blessed.” We have never experienced that. Imagine walking down the street and everybody knows your kids' names and moves the hell out of their way: that's brother so-and-so's kid. All people are going to know our children. That's double.

Write down the chain of events: awakening, which is us waking up; followed by tribulation, and we are between those now; World War III; Armageddon in the midst of that war, where Christ makes his advent; deliverance; wilderness; then kings and priests, rulership.

precepts.label: Sirach 31:13
precepts.why:
“Remember that a wicked eye is an evil thing: and what is created more wicked than an eye? therefore it weepeth upon every occasion.” The eye is where it starts. It starts with the desire of what you see, and then the mind decides whether to feed the lust.

That is why it belongs with Matthew 15. The Pharisees were arguing about eating with unwashed hands, and Christ told them that what goes in at the mouth goes into the belly and “is cast out into the draught”, but “those things which proceed out of the mouth come forth from the heart; and they defile the man.” What comes out of your mouth is the output value of what was put into your mind, and the eye is one of the ways it gets put in.

The brain stores everything you let in. A random song or thought from years ago comes out of you because it was saved in long-term memory, the same way your stuff on the internet never really leaves. What you put into your vessel determines what comes out, and a lot of times we don't even realize we are being controlled. You were made in a factory called America, and those are not your words. The only way to break that code is to reprogram and recode, and the wicked eye is where the guarding has to begin.

precepts.label: Job 31:1
precepts.why:
“I made a covenant with mine eyes; why then should I think upon a maid?” Job had to literally make a covenant: I'm not going to watch that, and if it gets within my eyesight, I got to turn away. I got to train my eyes to look away.

That is the three-second rule. The eyes are input. If you let yourself look at something for more than three seconds, it goes into your working memory, your short-term memory; keep looking at it and you are programming yourself into long-term memory. Turn away within three seconds and it doesn't have time to work within your memory. That is why TikTok gives you three seconds to capture somebody's attention, and why Netflix keeps it moving: once they have your attention through your eyes, they have you. Our eyes are the portal to take control over your vessel.

The algorithm is a reflection of you. Your searches and your scrolls tell who you are, what makes you sad, what makes you mad, what music you play when you're angry. So when you say the algorithm got you, it's not them getting you. It's you, manifested on a screen. The devil don't make you do anything you don't want to do.

David said the same: “I will set no wicked thing before mine eyes.” Train your eyes. If a show is full of action but something enticing comes on that goes against your values and your struggles, turn it off, click by. If you hear gossip or something negative, leave the conversation, because three seconds of listening will taint you, and three seconds of something negatively influencing you will control you.

precepts.why:
Christ said evil thoughts, adulteries, fornications, murders and the rest come “from within, out of the heart of men”, and “defile the man.” So how do those evil things get into your mind? Remember who the war is against: Satan. Acts shows how he does it.

“But a certain man named Ananias, with Sapphira his wife, sold a possession, And kept back part of the price, his wife also being privy to it, and brought a certain part, and laid it at the apostles' feet. But Peter said, Ananias, why hath Satan filled thine heart to lie to the Holy Ghost” What did Satan do? He filled his heart to lie. That lying spirit comes from Satan.

That is how he works. He is there in your head, whispering thoughts, tempting you, putting things there that are not there. The deacon says something to you and Satan says, why did he say that to you? The deacon don't like you. A husband gives his wife an order to clean the bathroom, and Satan whispers: you going to let him talk to you like that, after all you do in this house? He don't understand you; he don't love you. If she listens, she becomes bitter and it shows in her actions.

Satan puts things in everyone's head, the deacon included. The fight with Satan starts first and foremost in your mind, and many fall in this truth because they wait until the mind is already defiled. To win, you have to kill it right there: the thoughts Satan puts in your mind should never become action. Ask, why am I thinking like this? Fast and pray, Lord take these thoughts out of my mind, and answer him with the word of God, “the sword of the Spirit”, the weapon we fight with.

precepts.label: Isaiah 9:6-7
precepts.why:
“For unto us a child is born, unto us a son is given: and the government shall be upon his shoulder.” When Acts 7:38 speaks of “the church in the wilderness”, it is speaking of the government of Christ. That church was Israel, the twelve tribes, and it is his government that rests upon his shoulder.

“And his name shall be called Wonderful, Counsellor, The mighty God, The everlasting Father, The Prince of Peace.” Christ is called the everlasting Father because many times in the Old Testament, when you read about the Father, it is making reference to Christ. That is why, when Philip asked Christ to show them the Father, Christ answered that he had been so long time with him and still Philip had not known him. Christ is letting you know: I am the father that created you. Not the Father, but your father.

“Of the increase of his government and peace there shall be no end.” Increase means it starts small. Christ said the kingdom of heaven starts like a mustard seed, but in the end it is the largest. Once that mustard seed is planted and growing, there is no stopping it. It sits “upon the throne of David, and upon his kingdom, to order it, and to establish it with judgment and with justice from henceforth even for ever. The zeal of the Lord of hosts will perform this.”

This truth cannot be stopped. No matter how many Israelites they attempt to kill or arrest, the church that was in the wilderness, the government on Christ’s shoulder, keeps increasing and has no end.

precepts.label: Daniel 2:44
precepts.why:
“And in the days of these kings shall the God of heaven set up a kingdom, which shall never be destroyed.” These kings are the last kings of the image, the ten toes, the ten common markets, and America is that iron and that clay. In their days God sets up his kingdom, and that is what is happening now: Israelites are waking up all over the world.

“Which shall never be destroyed.” That says the same thing as Isaiah 9: “Of the increase of his government and peace there shall be no end.” The church in the wilderness, the twelve tribes under Christ’s government, is a kingdom God himself sets up, and it will not be brought down.

That is the difference between this truth and the movements of men. Asked in an interview how Israel in Christ differs from the Black Panthers, Martin Luther King, SNCC or the Young Lords, the answer was plain: those were all man-made, they all had an end, and most of them do not even exist today. This kingdom is not man-made.

“And the kingdom shall not be left to other people, but it shall break in pieces and consume all these kingdoms, and it shall stand for ever.” The God of heaven set it up, so no government of this world can stop it.

precepts.label: Matthew 16:15-18
precepts.why:
Christ asks, “But whom say ye that I am?” and Peter answers, “Thou art the Christ, the Son of the living God.” Christ tells him “flesh and blood hath not revealed it unto thee, but my Father which is in heaven.”

Then verse 18 is the key: “upon this rock I will build my church”. That rock is Christ himself, not Peter. And the church he builds is the same government we read of in Isaiah 9, the same church in the wilderness in Acts 7:38: Israel.

“And the gates of hell shall not prevail against it.” There is no stopping us. Once you get the proper understanding of the word of God, you cannot stop it; it is going to flourish and grow. The gates of hell will attempt to stop it, but they will not prevail. They attempted it when they murdered Nat Turner, Denmark Vesey and Gabriel Prosser, men who knew they were Israelites. They said kill them, and it did not stop. Through whispers and hushes, this word kept going.

The gates of hell are not a flesh and blood enemy: “For we wrestle not against flesh and blood, but against principalities, against powers, against the rulers of the darkness of this world, against spiritual wickedness in high places.” In our carnal mind we think that if we organize we can overthrow the system, but we cannot. The governments of this earth are set up by Satan, and God allows it. Only God can bring all that down, and Christ has promised that none of it will prevail against his church.

precepts.label: Amos 5:26
precepts.why:
The Iranians burned large statues of a horned, bull-headed figure bearing the so-called Star of David, and they knew what they were doing: they were burning statues of Baal. That is not the Star of David. You cannot find it anywhere in the Bible; it is a sign in the occult.

Stephen said, “Yea, ye took up the tabernacle of Moloch, and the star of your god Remphan, figures which ye made to worship them: and I will carry you away beyond Babylon.” If you didn't know, Moloch is Baal: the same thing, both the devil. The star is the star of their god, the devil, Baal or Moloch.

Stephen was quoting Amos: “But ye have borne the tabernacle of your Moloch and Chiun your images, the star of your god, which ye made to yourselves.” Which ye made to yourselves: it is idolatry. God did not give us that star. When King Solomon was dabbling in witchcraft, that is how he got that star; God never gave it to us.

So the star so-called Israel and America carry is the star of Baal, and Baal worship shows up in plain sight: the bull's head statue at the 1933 Chicago World's Fair on Jewish Day, the giant mechanical bull at the 2022 Commonwealth Games, the bull on Wall Street. Even bullheaded, stupidly stubborn, comes from Baal worship, and stubbornness is as iniquity and idolatry. That idolatry is why Israel was carried away, and why we are in captivity today.

precepts.why:
Paul and Barnabas went about “Confirming the souls of the disciples, and exhorting them to continue in the faith, and that we must through much tribulation enter into the kingdom of God.” The tribulation hasn't fully started; you see it on a certain scale, but it will intensify.
